speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but I do feel quite short of breath when I try to play basketball or do any physical work. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a critical piece of information; did the stroke occur before or after the cough began, and are you currently taking any anticoagulants like warfarin or aspirin? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray to check for pulmonary edema or hemorrhage.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrates or obvious masses.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with history of Ischemic Stroke.
